name: smwmusic-warioware-d-i-y-body-rock
title: WarioWare: D.I.Y. - Body Rock
description:
The song that plays throughout Jimmy T.'s stage in WarioWare D.I.Y. and makes you wanna dance with your DSi in one hand, and stylus in the other.

Includes both the English and Japanese "vocals", since the melody actually slightly differs between the two.

Also featured in the Team Pretzel Romhack Races level!
